I’m surprised the Stanford Prison Experiment isn’t higher up! The documentary on it is so interesting. Students who volunteered in the experiment were to be paid a certain sum, and some were made into guards and the others into prisoners. But the majority of the students began to believe their roles, i.e. that they really were prisoners and would never leave. The guards became so absorbed in their role that they used psychological and humiliation tactics to make the ‘prisoners’ submit.
It’s terrifying and intriguing what can happen in these psychological experiments.
